english.title: Supervisor of provisional licence holder fail to produce driving licence to a constable
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being a person supervising **(..SPECIFY PERSON..), the holder of a provisional licence, while

(A)_[he]_
(B)_[she]_

was driving a motor vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), on a road, namely **(..SPECIFY ROAD AND LOCATION..), on being so required by a constable, failed to produce for examination your licence
english.legislation: Contrary to section 164(6)of the Road Traffic Act 1988 and Schedule 2 to the Road Traffic Offenders Act 1988.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
being the supervisor of the holder of a provisional driving licence
driving a motor vehicle on a road
on being required by constable
to produce your driving licence failed to do so

english.standardstatementoffacts: At **(..SPECIFY TIME..) on **(..SPECIFY DATE..) the defendant was supervising **(..SPECIFY DRIVER..), the holder of a provisional licence, who was driving **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..) on **(..SPECIFY ROAD AND LOCATION..). The defendant failed to produce a current driving licence to a police constable when requested to do so, either then or within seven days thereafter.

welsh.welshoffencetitle: Goruchwyliwr deilydd trwydded dros dro yn methu dangos trwydded yrru i gwnstabl
welsh.welshstandardoffencewording:
Ar **(..SPECIFY DATE..) yn **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), a chithau'n goruchwylio **(..SPECIFY PERSON..), deilydd trwydded dros dro, tra oedd

(A)_[ef]_
(B)_[hi]_

yn gyrru cerbyd, sef **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), ar ffordd, sef **(..SPECIFY ROAD AND LOCATION..), ar orchymyn cwnstabl, bu i chi fethu dangos eich trwydded i'w harchwilio ganddo
welsh.welshstandardstatementoffacts: Ar **(..SPECIFY DATE..) am **(..SPECIFY TIME..) roedd y diffynnydd yn goruchwylio **(..SPECIFY DRIVER..), deilydd trwydded dros dro, a oedd yn gyrru **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..) ar **(..SPECIFY ROAD AND LOCATION..). Methodd y diffynnydd ddangos trwydded yrru gyfredol i gwnstabl pan ofynnwyd iddo wneud hynny, naill ai ar y pryd neu o fewn saith niwrnod wedi hynny.
welsh.welshlegislation: Yn groes i Adran 164(6) Deddf Traffig Ffyrdd 1988 ac Atodlen 2 Deddf Troseddwyr Traffig Ffyrdd 1988.
